Weak points

#SeverityFindingWhy it matters / what to doParts / nets
F001critical12268 track segment(s) below the 0.127 mm fab minimum
MFG-TRACK-WIDTH · manufacturing		Narrowest track: 0.100 mm. Over-etching on thin tracks causes opens and lower yield.
Widen tracks to at least 0.159 mm where space allows, or choose a fab profile that supports them.
+1V8, +1V15, +3V3, +3V3_AON, +5V, +5V_AON, +5V_SOM, +12V, +20V, /CSI/CAM0.CSI2_CLK+
F002critical3235 via(s) with drill below 0.30 mm
MFG-VIA · manufacturing		Mechanical drills below the fab minimum need laser drilling (HDI) or are rejected.
Increase via drill to >= 0.30 mm or order an HDI process.
F003critical51 capacitor(s) exceed voltage derating
REL-CAP-VOLTAGE · reliability		Over-stressed capacitors fail early: tantalums short (and burn), electrolytics wear out, class-II ceramics lose most of their capacitance under DC bias.
Pick parts with a higher voltage rating (ceramic >= 2x, tantalum >= 2x, electrolytic >= 1.25x working voltage).		C3, C4, C12, C13, C14, C15, C16, C25, C54, C75, C118, C121, C124, C135, C139, C147, C231, C244, C245, C247 ...
F004major4 copper item(s) closer than 0.30 mm to the board edge
MFG-EDGE-CLEARANCE · manufacturing		Routing/scoring exposes or burrs copper that sits this close to the edge (shorts to enclosure, delamination).
Pull copper back to >= 0.38 mm from Edge.Cuts or ask the fab for edge plating.		H5, H6, H7, H8
GND
F005major1 hole pair(s) closer than 0.25 mm
MFG-HOLE-SPACING · manufacturing		Thin webs between drills crack or merge during drilling.
Increase spacing between the holes.
F006majorBoard is finer than Eurocircuits supports (pattern, drill)
MFG-TECH-CLASS · manufacturing		No level of Eurocircuits pattern + drill classes accepts these features: via hole to inner-layer copper 0.1705 at pattern 9 (limit 0.2); inner copper gap 0.075 at pattern 9 (limit 0.09); via hole (finished) 0.1 at drill D (limit 0.15); component plated hole (finished) 0.1 at drill D (limit 0.15).
Widen the listed features, or choose a finer process or another class system.
F007major9024 feature(s) break Eurocircuits process limits
MFG-TECH-CLASS · manufacturing		aspect ratio (thickness : drill): 3258 (worst 8.555 vs 8.0); outer track width: 4966 (worst 0.1 vs 0.125); outer copper gap: 800 (worst 0.0996 vs 0.125).
These limits apply to every class of Eurocircuits pattern + drill classes.
F008major3235 via(s) exceed aspect ratio 8:1 (board 1.71 mm)
MFG-VIA-ASPECT · manufacturing		High aspect-ratio holes plate unevenly: thin barrel copper cracks under thermal cycling.
Use larger drills or a thinner board.
F009majorNo fiducials on the top side (518 SMD parts)
ASM-FIDUCIALS · assembly		Pick-and-place machines need >= 2 global fiducials per populated side for accurate placement.
Add 2-3 fiducials in opposite corners of the top side, or confirm that the panel rails carry them.
F010majorNo fiducials on the bottom side (375 SMD parts)
ASM-FIDUCIALS · assembly		Pick-and-place machines need >= 2 global fiducials per populated side for accurate placement.
Add 2-3 fiducials in opposite corners of the bottom side, or confirm that the panel rails carry them.
F011major62 through-hole pad(s) with solid plane connection
ASM-THT-SOLID-ZONE · assembly		The plane sinks heat away: hole fill is poor in wave/selective soldering and hand soldering creates cold joints.
Use thermal-relief spokes for THT pads (zone 'Thermal reliefs for PTH' or pad override).		H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, H7, H8, H9, H10, H11, H12, H13, J2, J3, J5, J6, J7, J8, J9 ...
/SFP/SH, GND, VCC_IN
F012major128 small part(s) with unbalanced pad heating
ASM-TOMBSTONE · assembly		One pad heats much slower than the other (solid plane, wide track or via); surface tension then lifts the part on end during reflow (tombstoning/open joint).
Use thermal reliefs on the plane connection and equal-width tracks on both pads.		C5, C13, C23, C25, C31, C40, C52, C53, C54, C55, C56, C62, C71, C74, C77, C84, C86, C88, C91, C104 ...
F013major617 via(s) inside SMD pads
ASM-VIA-IN-PAD · assembly		Open vias in pads wick solder away from the joint (starved joints, voids) unless they are filled and capped.
Move vias next to the pad (dog-bone) or order filled & capped vias (IPC-4761 type VII).		C27, C28, C29, C31, C32, C33, C35, C36, C37, C42, C43, C45, C46, C48, C49, C50, C52, C53, C54, C55 ...
F014major20 MLCC(s) within 3.0 mm of the board edge
ASM-MLCC-EDGE · reliability		Board flexing during depaneling, ICT, connector insertion or screwing cracks MLCCs; cracks short the rail later in the field. Perpendicular orientation (terminals at different distances from the edge) is worst.
Move MLCCs >= 3.0 mm from edges and V-score lines, orient them parallel to the edge, or use soft-termination / flexible-termination parts.		C6, C39, C104, C155, C157, C164, C173, C175, C179, C209, C226, C239, C370, C371, C372, C373, C374, C375, C377, C387
F015major53 power net(s) cannot be probed
TEST-POWER-ACCESS · testability		Rails without probe access cannot be verified on the production tester.
Add a >= 0.9 mm test pad on the bottom side for each listed rail. The other side reaches +5V, +5V_AON, +20V, /DCDC/1V8_OUT, /DCDC/1V15_OUT, /DCDC/3V3_OUT: probe both sides (testplan.probe_side = "both", two fixture plates).
+1V8, +1V15, +3V3_AON, +5V, +5V_AON, +5V_SOM, +12V, +20V, /CSI/CSIA_3V3, /CSI/CSIA_5V
F016major7 schematic part(s) missing on the board
DOC-SCH-SYNC · documentation		The board was not updated from the schematic.
Run 'Update PCB from Schematic' (F8).		C?, D?, J?, Q?, R?, TP?, U?
F017minor165 acute track junction(s) (< 80 deg)
MFG-ACID-TRAP · manufacturing		Acute copper angles trap etchant and can over-etch, creating thin necks.
Re-route the junctions with 45/90 degree entries.
F018minor23 plated hole pad(s) with annular ring close to the minimum
MFG-THT-ANNULAR · manufacturing		Rings within 25% of the fab limit.
Enlarge pads where possible.		U30
F019minor3531 track segment(s) close to the 0.127 mm fab minimum

+1V8, +3V3_AON, +5V, /DCDC/3V3_VDD, /DCDC/16V_BOOT, /DCDC/16V_MODE1, /DCDC/16V_MODE2, /DCDC/16V_PHASE, /DCDC/20V_BOOT, /DCDC/20V_EN
F020minor13 large/heavy SMD part(s) on the bottom side
ASM-BOTTOM-HEAVY · assembly		In double-sided reflow, heavy bottom parts can drop or shift during the second pass.
Move them to the top side or specify adhesive dots for the bottom side.		H1, H2, H3, H4, H11, H12, H13, J8, J10, J11, J13, J14, J18
F021minor32 component(s) within 0.5 mm of (or over) the edge
ASM-COMPONENT-EDGE · assembly		Parts at the edge collide with panel rails, conveyor clamps and depaneling tools.
Keep courtyards >= 3.0 mm inside the outline or add breakaway rails.		C226, C377, D3, D4, D5, D6, D10, D12, D24, D26, D28, D29, D31, D37, D38, D40, D41, D42, D43, D44 ...
F022minor56 fine-pitch (<= 0.5 mm) part(s)
ASM-FINE-PITCH · assembly		Fine pitch raises the risk of solder bridges and insufficient joints.
Use a <= 0.12 mm stencil with reduced apertures, solder-mask dams between pads and AOI after reflow.		J3, J5, J6, J7, J9, J10, J11, J13, J14, Q21, Q26, Q27, Q29, U1, U5, U7, U8, U11, U12, U13 ...
F023minorAssembly process: SMT top (518 parts) + SMT bottom (375 parts) + THT (2 parts: wave, selective or hand soldering)
ASM-PROCESS · assembly		Each extra process step adds cost and handling (handling = flex & ESD exposure). Bottom SMD + THT usually needs selective soldering or a wave pallet.
The generated solder jig holds the THT parts for hand soldering.		J2, J19
F024minor12 flex-sensitive part(s) within 3 mm of mounting holes
REL-MOUNTING · reliability		Screw torque bends the board locally and cracks MLCCs / BGA joints.
Keep MLCCs and area-array packages away from screws or use standoffs with washers.		C27, C135, C160, C161, C178, C181, C185, C202, C206, C227, C237
F025minor6 connector(s) without through-hole anchors
REL-SMD-CONNECTOR · reliability		Mating forces and cable strain go straight into SMD solder joints; pads rip off after repeated use.
Use connector variants with through-hole shell tabs/pegs, or add an enclosure strain relief.		J1, J10, J11, J15, J16, J17
F026minor13 exposed pad(s) without thermal vias
REL-THERMAL-PAD · reliability		Without vias the exposed pad cannot spread heat; the part runs hot and ages faster.
Add an array of 0.3 mm vias (tented or filled on the bottom to limit solder voids).		Q5, Q9, Q23, Q24, Q25, U1, U14, U34, U43, U56, U59, U71, U80
F027minor59 power net(s) contain tracks narrower than 0.30 mm
REL-POWER-TRACKS · electrical		Thin power tracks drop voltage and heat up; capacity shown is IPC-2221 at 10 C rise (35 um Cu). Set nets.<name>.max_current_a in the config to turn this into a hard check.
Widen power tracks where space allows.
